paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Yevamot 121b](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.121b.15), where Rav Yosef permitted Chiyuai’s wife to remarry; see there.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson vocalized text of Yevamot 121b identifies Chiyuai as the man reported dead and Rav Yosef as the sage permitting Chiyuai’s wife to remarry.

After hearing the offhand report of Chiyuai’s death, Rav Yosef permits Chiyuai’s wife to remarry. The next anecdote concerns a different man, a horseman from Pumbedita, and gives Rava as an alternative attribution to Rav Yosef.
